note: Read 2026-10-31. India Code and the Labour Ministry's site timed out or reset today; the texts were read elsewhere, as named. Majority: The Majority Act, 1875 (Act No. 9 of 1875), s. 3 as substituted by Act 33 of 1999 (w.e.f. 16 December 1999), in the copy the High Court of Tripura publishes: every person domiciled in India attains majority on completing eighteen years and not before (the old rule of twenty-one for a ward with a court-appointed guardian went with the 1999 substitution). S. 2 leaves marriage, dower, divorce and adoption to personal law (not held). Work: The Child Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Amendment Act, 2016 (No. 35 of 2016, Gazette of India Extraordinary, in force 1 September 2016), renaming the 1986 Act the Child and Adolescent Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Act: a child is under fourteen (or the Right to Education Act's age, if higher); an adolescent fourteen to seventeen; s. 3(1): no child may be employed in any occupation or process; adolescents may work outside the hazardous occupations and processes of the Schedule (s. 3A, not held). So the form's 14. Exceptions for helping a family enterprise after school (s. 3(2)(a)) aren't held. Performers: s. 3(2)(b): the bar doesn't apply where a child works as an artist in the audio-visual entertainment industry (advertisements, films, television serials, other entertainment or sport, not the circus), under the conditions prescribed, and without affecting schooling. The prescribed conditions are rule 2C of the Child and Adolescent Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Rules, 1988 (as amended by G.S.R. 543(E), 2 June 2017): the producer may involve a child only after the permission of the District Magistrate of the district where the activity takes place, with an undertaking, the parents' consent, at most five hours a day and three without rest. The central rules' text wasn't reached; the wording was read in the Government of Puducherry's gazette of 8 July 2020 (draft rules that copy rule 2C), marked secondary. No lowest age is set. Service: Service is held null: no source saying no service is asked was reached today (the blocker file names the attempts); a reading only, not held: India has no conscription (the armed forces, including the Agnipath scheme, recruit volunteers).
